meta.name: render-flat-vector-explainer
meta.description: Assemble the FREE steps of the flat-vector-explainer video format — a flat-illustration creator-character walks a countable N-step product routine, one step per beat, and Remotion composites every chip/numeral/tagline/slate/CTA as an animated DOM overlay ON TOP of the Kling i2v character clips (text is NEVER baked into a keyframe — i2v warps type), the closing 'N products' grid is a PIL composite of the REAL product photos (not AI), full-sentence VO drives word-by-word burned captions over a VO-forward music bed, and the ~50s animated silent master is re-cut to a 30s deliverable FROM the animated master (never a static intermediate). Documentation-grade — ships config.example.json + PIPELINE.md + a README of the free assembly; the paid gen steps (keyframes, Kling i2v, VO, music) are separate capabilities the recipe orchestrates. Use for the flat-vector-explainer format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组装扁平矢量讲解视频的免费步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要按模板组装扁平矢量风格的讲解视频。
copy.tagline_en: Assemble the free steps of a flat-vector explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assemble a flat-vector explainer video from a recipe.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你组装一个扁平矢量风格的产品讲解视频：用 Remotion 在 Kling 动画上叠加文字标签、数字、产品图片等，最后用 PIL 合成真实产品网格，并添加配音和字幕，输出约 50 秒或 30 秒的成品。
howto.when: 当你需要制作一个扁平矢量风格的、分步骤讲解产品使用流程的短视频时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个护肤步骤的扁平矢量讲解视频，共5步。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤组装视频，包括动画、文字和产品图片。

say.text: 用这个配方生成一个30秒的咖啡冲泡教程视频。
say.note: Claude 会从动画母版中裁剪出30秒版本。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude assembles a flat-vector product-routine explainer video: composites text overlays (chips, numerals, taglines) on Kling i2v clips via Remotion, builds a real product photo grid with PIL, adds captions and audio, and outputs a ~50s or 30s deliverable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a flat-vector step-by-step product routine explainer video.

say_en.text: Create a flat-vector skincare routine explainer with 5 steps.
say_en.note: Claude will assemble the video with animations, text, and product photos.

say_en.text: Generate a 30-second coffee brewing tutorial using this recipe.
say_en.note: Claude will cut the 30s version from the animated master.
